name: Night Drive
author: Trance
description: 1986, after midnight: a road of light running to the horizon under a striped sun going down in yellow and pink, between wireframe mountains in violet and cyan. The bass puts your foot down and swells the sun, the stripes slide down it with the beat, the mids stir the ridges and the cymbals set the stars twinkling.
frame:
sunY = 0.3
sunR = 0.34 + 0.015*min(bass_att, 2)
drive = 0.28 + 0.16*min(bass_att, 2)
slide = slide + dt*(0.15 + 0.35*min(bass_att, 2))

layers.code:
x = (noise(n*7.3, 1) - 0.5)*2*aspect*1.05
y = 0.12 + 0.9*noise(n*3.1, 2)
radius = 0.003 + 0.004*noise(n*1.7, 3)
a = (0.3 + 0.7*noise(n*5.1, time*(0.5 + 2*min(treb_att, 2))))*smoothstep(0.1, 0.3, y)*smoothstep(sunR, sunR + 0.06, length(x, y - sunY))

layers.point:
u = t*2 - 1
val = smoothstep(0.16, 0.5, abs(u))
ridge = 0.3 + 0.7*abs(noise(u*6, travel*1.2)*2 - 1)
x = u*13
z = (1 - i)*20
y = -1 + val*ridge*(4.6 + 0.6*min(mid_att, 2)) + 0.1*v
a = a*smoothstep(0.04, 0.2, val)

R = 64
row = floor(i*R + 0.5)
ss = (row + 0.5)/R
yy = sunY + sunR*(1 - 2*ss)
x = (t*2 - 1)*sqrt(max(0, sunR*sunR - (yy - sunY)*(yy - sunY)))
y = yy
z = 0
gap = clamp((ss - 0.4)*1.4, 0, 0.65)
a = a*step(gap, fract(ss*9 - slide))*below(row, R - 0.5)*step(0.06, yy)
